book.name: Colosse
book.title: Paul Letta Ta Dem Een Colosse

content: A, Paul, wa God pick fa be a postle ob Jedus Christ, an Timothy, we Christian broda.
We da write ta God people een Colosse, we bredren wa true ta God cause dey come fa be one wid Christ. We da aks God we Fada fa bless oona an gii oona peace een oona haat.
We Tell God Tankya Wen We Pray fa Oona
All de time wen we pray fa oona, we tell God de Fada ob we Lawd Jedus Christ tankya.
We tank um cause we yeh how oona trus een Jedus Christ an how oona lob all God people.

Cause wen dey tell oona de true wod, de Good Nyews, oona yeh say God da keep safe een heaben wa oona da wait fa. An wen ya know fa sho dat ya gwine git wa ya da wait fa, dat mek ya trus een Jedus Christ fa true an lob God people.

De Good Nyews da spread all oba de wol, an e da grow an git mo an mo people fa bleebe an do good, jes like a fruit tree da beah good crop. Same way so, fom de day wen dat Good Nyews reach oona, oona yeh an ondastan fa true how God show e blessin pon oona.
Oona laan dis fom Epaphras, wa we lob an wa da do Christ wok longside we. E faitful bout de wok wa e da do fa Christ fa hep oona.
E done splain ta we how God Sperit da gii oona lob fa oona Christian bredren.

Cause ob dat, fom de day wen we yeh bout oona, we ain neba stop fa pray fa oona. We aks um fa mek e Sperit gii oona sense an mek oona ondastan all bout um, so dat oona gwine know all wa God wahn oona fa do.
We da aks God fa dat, cause den oona gwine be able fa lib like God people oughta lib an all de time oona gwine do wa mek God heppy. Oona gwine lib da do all kind ob good wok, an know God mo an mo.
We da pray dat God, wid all e powa, mek oona git scrong mind an haat so dat oona gwine be able fa beah all ting. Ya ain gwine grumble, no matta wa happen. Ya gwine hab a heppy haat.
Oona mus tell we Fada God tankya, cause e mek we fa be people wa fit fa git we paat ob wa e promise fa gii e people, wen e da rule een de light.
Cause God done pull we outta we sinful way wa beena git powa oba we an mek we lib een de daak. An God done bring we safe fa lib onda e Son powa, e Son wa e lob fa true.
God Son, e de one wa set we free fom sin powa oba we. Wen e shed e blood pon de cross, e paadon we.
Christ an de Wok E Do
Ain nobody kin see God. Bot wen we see wa Christ like, we see pazactly wa God like. God ain mek nottin fo Christ been dey. Christ fus been dey, an Christ oba ebryting wa God mek.

Shru Christ, God mek all e mek, all wa dey een heaben an een dis wol, wa people kin see an wa people ain able fa see. E mek dem sperit, dem wa got powa an hab shrone, dem wa da rule an wa hab tority. Shru Christ, God mek all. An e mek um all fa gii hona ta Christ.
Christ been dey fus. God ain mek nottin fo Christ dey. An Christ da mek ebryting stay een dey place weh dey spose fa stay.
Christ de head ob de body, de choch. E da gii de body life. E been de fus fa be dey, an de fus wa God mek git op fom mongst de dead an lib gin, so dat e gwine hab fus place oba all.
Cause e Fada God been heppy fa mek Christ all dat God da.
An shru e Son Christ, God heppy fa bring all wa een dis wol an all wa een heaben back ta esef. God mek peace wid all, shru Christ, wen Christ shed e blood an dead pon de cross.
Fo oona bleebe pon Christ, oona been ton way fom God. Oona been e enemy cause ob de sinful ting oona beena tink an do.

Bot now Christ done come wid a body as a man an e done dead pon de cross. Cause ob dat, God bring oona ta esef an mek oona e fren, so dat wen oona stanop fo um, oona gwine be holy. Oona ain gwine hab no sin tall, an oona ain gwine hab no blame fa nottin.

Bot oona mus bleebe de Good Nyews fa sho. Mus dohn doubt God eben a leetle bit. Oona mus dohn leh nobody ton oona way fom de hope fa de ting dem wa de Good Nyews mek oona hope fa. Dis de Good Nyews dat oona yeh, an dat all people een de wol beena yeh. An, A, Paul, da wok fa tell people dat Good Nyews.
Paul Wok fa de Choch
Now A da suffa fa oona an A heppy fa dat. Cause by de pain wa A da suffa een me body, A da hep finish op wa still lef ob Christ suffrin fa de sake ob e body, de choch.
God pick me fa saab de choch so dat A kin tell oona all de wod dat God gii me.
Fo now, all de time, God ain leh nobody een de wol know dis wod yah. Bot now e da tell um ta e own people.
God wahn fa mek e own people know e wod dat nobody ain been neba know, dis special wod dat e wahn all people fa yeh, dat Christ da lib dey eenside oona haat an oona gwine hab a paat een God glory.

So den, we da tell all people bout Christ. Wid all de sense God gii we, we da waan um wa dey ain oughta do an laan um wa dey oughta do, so dat all ob um kin know all dat God wahn um fa do, an dey gwine wahn fa do um wid all dey haat. Een dat way, dey kin be one wid Christ fa true.
Dis de ting A da wok haad as A kin fa do. An A da nyuse all de great powa wa dey eenside me, wa Christ gii me. Dat mek me able fa do wa A da do.
